title: Separate the variables
text: Write the equation as $$\frac{dP}{P \left(10+P\right)}=-dt$$ and use partial fractions: $$\frac{1}{P \left(10+P\right)}=\frac{1}{10} \left(\frac{1}{P}-\frac{1}{10+P}\right)$$.

title: Integrate and solve
text: This gives $$\frac{1}{10}\ln\left|\frac{P}{10+P}\right|=-t+C$$ so $$\frac{P}{10+P}=A e^{\left(-10t\right)}$$. At $$t=0$$, $$A=\frac{2}{12}=\frac{1}{6}$$. Solving for $$P$$ gives $$P=\frac{10}{6e^{10t}-1}$$.
